title: The Minimal Dimension of Entangled-Noise Advantage
summary: Can entangled noise erase entanglement more efficiently than separable noise? Standard robustness restricts the added noise to separable states; generalized robustness allows any state. We prove that the two costs coincide for every two-qubit state and give an explicit full-rank qubit--qutrit state with a strict gap. Positivity under partial transpose (PPT) characterizes separability in both dimensions, so the boundary is not caused by a failure of the PPT criterion.
